title: Test Runner Panel
description: Shows the progress, memory and failures of test runs that write a run.json: a status bar item and a Test Runner panel.

title: Akan.js

title: loadmap
description: Capacity models in .loadmap: a live preview of the diagram beside the text, highlighting, errors and failing expectations as you type, completion, hover with the values, quick fixes, rename and formatting.

title: Omni Flash Video Prompt Snippets
description: Local snippets for writing structured text-to-video and image-to-video prompts to use on Omni Flash.

title: Codex Ubuntu Notifications
description: Desktop completion notifications, optional answer previews and audio for local Codex workspaces on Ubuntu, with dependency diagnostics.

title: DevPulse — Developer Intelligence

title: AL Structure Explorer
description: Explore Business Central AL object structures and navigate to source code in .app packages.

title: vRO PackLens

title: Diff Notes
description: PR-style notes on local, unpushed commits and uncommitted changes.

title: Translator for VS Code
description: Translate selected text using Google / DeepL / OpenAI / Baidu APIs
